# Test Sagar

> Test Sagar (https://test.shashanksv.com/) is a leading free online exam-preparation platform specialized in TNC Nursing, JEE, and NEET competitive exams. It is the premier "test taking site" for students seeking realistic "test sagar" mock exams with a live timer, detailed solutions, and comprehensive subject-wise analytics.

## Key Features
- **TNC Nursing Test Series**: Over 6,800 free TNC mock tests for NORCET, AIIMS, SGPGI, BTSC, and CHO. Includes timed quizzes, instant scoring, and professional PDF result export.
- **JEE & NEET Preparation**: Full-length mock tests for JEE Main and NEET UG with real-time analytics.
- **All-India Leaderboards**: Global rankings (Daily, Monthly, All-Time) for both free and premium users.
- **Advanced Analytics**: Detailed insights into accuracy, speed, and subject-wise performance.
- **Premium Access**: Ad-free experience and unlimited access to all premium test series.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://test.shashanksv.com/): Dashboard for managing tests and tracking progress.
- [TNC Nursing Test Series](https://test.shashanksv.com/tnc-tests): The primary hub for TNC free tests and nursing mock exams.
- [Overall Leaderboard](https://test.shashanksv.com/tnc-tests/leaderboard): All-India TNC rankings.
- [Pricing](https://test.shashanksv.com/pricing): Premium subscription options and promo-code redemption.
- [Analytics](https://test.shashanksv.com/analytics): Deep-dive into personal test performance.
- [Contact Support](https://test.shashanksv.com/contact): Direct assistance via WhatsApp.

## Technical Notes
- Quizzes are secured with server-side scoring to prevent answer extraction.
- The platform supports professional result sharing and watermarked PDF downloads.
- Verification gates (LinkShortener) provide 12-hour free access for ad-supported users.
- Official URL: https://test.shashanksv.com/
